axes.C: One coherent hotkeys spec, separate from asset roster, party mutation and asynchronous thumbnail lifecycle. Fresh GameState per case. Before hook captures exact listener/options and restores spy; after hook closes through owner, then always removes captured listeners/restores mocks in finally.

Real source mutant retains opening prevention and removes closing prevention: selected old passes, new exactly one business AssertionError. Exact source/test restore. Six adjacent files44/TC0. axes.F: dev-panel.hotkeys.test.ts names real responsibility. makeHotkeyDeps expresses local fixture domain. Existing event and dependency names are clear in their small lexical scope; no wholesale abbreviation policy or contributor labels remain.
axes.G: One128-line mixed-label spec remains one coherent spec after scope review, no gratuitous splitting. Shared suite state/setup become per-case; no implementation, public disposer, fixture export or shared configuration changes. Static CSS remains module-owned until isolated test environment teardown, not removed behind its injection flag.
axes.H: Real native events and public UI close entry; no core business mocks. Per-case state and listeners prevent cross-case dependence. Existing intentional console.log capture asserts actual dump data; warnings/errors not muted. DEV=false, full dump schema and production observer cleanup are separate claims, not inferred from green.
